intro: One small bowl of pineapple (about 150 g) has roughly 80 kcal. Nearly all the calories come from the fruit's natural sugar.

variants.name: Canned pineapple in syrup, 1 small bowl

diet: Yes. Fresh pineapple is low in calories, juicy and refreshing. It's a good swap for sweet drinks or kuih in the afternoon. Skip the canned-in-syrup version and sweetened juice if you want to save calories.
tips: Buy cut pineapple at the fruit stall and have it as an afternoon snack at the office.
Choose fresh pineapple or canned in its own juice, not syrup.
Add pineapple to a chicken salad or stir-fry it with prawns for a more protein-rich dish.

swap.name: Fresh pineapple instead of pineapple juice
swap.why: Fresh fruit is more filling because of the fibre, and it has no added sugar like juice does.

faq.q: Why does my mouth feel itchy after eating pineapple?
faq.a: Pineapple has an enzyme called bromelain that can make your mouth sting or itch. Soaking it in salt water for a bit can reduce that.
Many mums eat pineapple in normal amounts. If you have concerns, ask your doctor first.

faq.q: Can I eat pineapple on an empty stomach?
faq.a: Some people get a sore stomach because pineapple is acidic. If that's you, eat it after a main meal.
